title: Friends don't let friends print meter tape to ship
summary: Learn how printing shipping labels can be much more cost effective than printing meter tape from your mail machine
body_markdown:
### Efficiency and time savings


#### 1. Convenience and savings


**Shipping labels:** Printing shipping labels is straightforward and can be done directly from your computer or smartphone where, after weighing the package, all other aspects – cost, cheapest carrier, etc. - are automatically completed.[PitneyShip shipping software](https://www.pitneybowes.com/us/shipping-software.html?cm_sp=shipping_office_blog_08212024) integrates with existing platforms, automatically importing shipment details and streamlining the label creation process. This saves time and reduces the risk of errors.


**Meter tape:** Using a postage meter requires more steps, including weighing the package, selecting the class of service and printing the tape. This process can be time-consuming, especially for businesses handling a high volume of shipments.


#### 2. Batch processing


**Shipping labels:** Shipping labels can be printed in batches, allowing businesses to process multiple shipments simultaneously. This is particularly beneficial during peak shipping seasons or for businesses with high shipping volumes.


**Meter tape:** While some advanced postage meters offer batch processing, it is generally less efficient, more cumbersome, and charged at a much higher postage rate when compared to printing labels.


### Additional benefits of shipping labels


#### 1. Tracking and integration


**Shipping labels:** These labels ***automatically*** include tracking information, which is crucial for both the sender and recipient. This allows for real-time tracking and a better customer experience. PitneyShip multi-carrier shipping software allows you to rate compare across one carrier or multiple carriers and keeps all of your shipping and mailing activity in one application.


**Meter tapes: Meter tapes have no ability to track your package.**


#### 2. Flexibility and scalability


**Shipping labels:** This offers greater flexibility and scalability. Whether you're shipping a few packages a week or thousands, the process remains efficient and cost-effective. This adaptability is essential for growing businesses.


**Meter tapes:** Because meter tape requires a meter, scalability is limited to the processing capabilities of the meter.
